title: Glowing kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8a0' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffdd44' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd44' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff2266'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc1155'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7755'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff3355'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='crossGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffee55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- kite diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,10 82,42 50,74 18,42' fill='url(#kiteGrad)' stroke='#ff8899' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- horizontal cross spar -->
  <line x1='22' y1='42' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='url(#crossGrad)' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- vertical cross spar -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='url(#crossGrad)' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- top panel highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,12 78,42 50,42' fill='#ff6688' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bottom panel highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,42 78,42 50,72' fill='#dd2255' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- left panel highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,12 22,42 50,42' fill='#ff5577' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- tail string -->
  <path d='M50,74 Q45,82 52,86 Q58,90 50,94' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail bows -->
  <path d='M48,78 L52,76 L54,80 L50,80 Z' fill='#55ddff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M52,85 L56,83 L58,87 L54,87 Z' fill='#55ddff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M50,91 L54,89 L56,93 L52,93 Z' fill='#55ddff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- little glowing stars -->
  <g fill='#ffffcc'>
    <polygon points='24,26 25,29 28,29 25.8,31 26.8,34 24,32 21.2,34 22.2,31 20,29 23,29' opacity='0.7'/>
    <polygon points='74,20 75,23 78,23 75.8,25 76.8,28 74,26 71.2,28 72.2,25 70,23 73,23' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
